page.layout: One printed plate page. Above the plate, a caption in a box across the top. Below it, a dark plate with 12 coin images in 4 rows of 3. In each row, an obverse (left) sits beside a reverse (centre), and a second reverse (right) follows in rows 1 to 3. Row 4 has three reverses. A library stamp sits at the lower left, outside the plate, and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: NVMMI PRÆSIDVM SYRIÆ CVM ÆRA ANTIOCHENA· A PVGNA
Coin 1, obverse, head with no legible legend.
ΑΝΤΙΟΧΕΩΝ ΕΠΙ ΦΙΛΟΥ[?] (reverse, legend around the rim; field: a seated figure, ΕΚ)
ΑΝΤΙΟΧΕΩΝ ΕΠΙ ΦΙΛ[?] (reverse, legend around the rim; field: a seated figure)
ΑΥΤΟΚΡ[?] ΚΑΙΣ[?] ΣΕΒΑΣΤΟΥ (obverse, legend around the head, row 3)
ΕΠΙ ΣΙΛΑΝΟΥ ΑΝΤΙΟΧΕΩΝ ΒΜ (row 2 reverse, field: a goat with a star, ΒΜ)
ΕΠΙ ΣΙΛΑΝΟΥ ΑΝΤΙΟΧΕΩΝ ΣΚ (row 2 right reverse, field: a seated figure, ΣΚ)

page.notes: The caption and coin legends are the only printed text. Greek legends on the coins are small and partly worn, so the readings are doubtful where marked [?]. The obverse legends are mostly not legible on the scan. The field letters and the distribution of legends across the reverses are read from the image and may be imprecise. The caption's final word is hard to read at this resolution.
